headline: Should Lockheed's AI-Driven Fighter Autonomy Tests Reshape the Next-Gen Defense Narrative for LMT Investors?
summary: In recent tests, Lockheed Martin’s Skunk Works, the U.S. Air Force Test Pilot School and partners used an AI agent on the X-62 VISTA to autonomously execute 27 live air intercepts using real-time sensor data.
